name: UBTECH Walker Tienkung Embodied Intelligence
summary: A 1.72 m open research humanoid with two 6-DOF hands and full motor and sensor APIs, orderable in Germany from RobotShop Europe (as Walker E Pro) or through Terra Robotics.

priceEur.note: RobotShop Europe price shown with VAT for Germany; includes two 6-DOF dexterous hands, wireless controller and 200 W power adapter.

germany.leadTime: RobotShop: on-demand item, ordered from the supplier; due date shown at checkout

sellers.name: RobotShop Europe (RobotShop inc., eu.robotshop.com)
sellers.note: Listed as Walker E Embodied Intelligence, manufacturer no. Walker E Pro; on-demand item with add-to-cart and quote request.

sellers.name: Terra Robotics (Terra Connect GmbH)
sellers.note: Variant "Embodied intelligence"; metadata price EUR 178,000, basis not stated, not displayed.

germany.statusNote: RobotShop Europe sells this robot as "Walker E Embodied Intelligence" (Walker E Pro, also known as Tienkung) at EUR 124,409.10 incl. VAT, on demand, with delivery to Germany; Terra Robotics quotes on request.

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: UBTECH: 3 h endurance; Terra: 3.5 h operation, 6 h standby

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: Intel Core i7 + 2 x NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin (550 TOPS)

specs.label: Software
specs.value: ROS 2, full motor and sensor API, URDF models, RL training frameworks

notes: Research and education platform; UBTECH sells it under AI Education, RobotShop under the name Walker E Pro.
The 3 kg payload is per hand, from UBTECH's product page.
Runtime about 3 h continuous, 6 h standby (RobotShop and Terra).
